decisions.reason: Because the fifteen-day express program is closely related to the firm's existing manufacturing and service capabilities and remained on the website through 2024, management would likely keep it, though there is some risk it is later folded into broader express offerings.

The seventy-two-hour express program builds directly on the firm's domestic production, logistics, and customization know-how, so absorptive capacity is high enough to justify keeping it despite the operational strain of very fast delivery.
As a dedicated express-delivery product line with its own page in both years, this offer shows strong market commitment and fits the firm's established knowledge base exceptionally well.

The online ordering and digital services platform extends the firm's one-stop service model and was sustained on its own page across both years, suggesting the firm can learn and improve it even if digital capabilities are somewhat less traditional than its fabrication expertise.

The fire and smoke protection door is very close to the firm's safety-critical core competences and gained visibility from a mention in 2023 to its own page in 2024, which is a strong signal of successful commercialization and learning.
